relevant_laws.quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 30 feet upon the approach to any official traffic-control signal located at the side of a highway.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct roadside official signal approach halt restriction
relevant_laws.notes: Official status, signal function, highway side and actual approach body geometry require original review.
